scientific_integrity: Previously published prime-record and primorial-block facts are credited. The proof of logarithmic discrepancy and signed residue split is given in full; finite tests do not replace its induction. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The constants have convergent explicit series and rational error bounds; rationality, elementary closed forms and analogous theorems for arbitrary moduli are not claimed.
title: Logarithmic discrepancy and a permanent modulo-six bias in greedy coprime records
